summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by resolving the through model lazily using the class_prepared signal. However, it introduces a potential behavioral regression risk and could be improved for maintainability.

issues.description: The use of the class_prepared signal might introduce unexpected side effects or timing issues, especially if other signals or logic depend on the through model being resolved at a specific point during class loading.
The added code could be made more readable by extracting the signal connection logic into a separate method or function.
